_meta: One-time destination-slug -> region mapping for scripts/import_legacy_dataset.py (see docs/LEGACY_IMPORT_AUDIT_v19.md). Every value must be one of app.db.models.DESTINATION_REGIONS. A slug is listed here only once its region is confirmed by a human, never inferred at runtime — the importer aborts if any destination in the source dataset is missing from this file. Add the remaining slugs (see the importer's own error output for the exact list) once a real decision is made for each.
